- Leathery, sunburned appearance
- Upper canopy leaves most affected
- No distinct spots, lesions, or fungal structures visible
- No interveinal pattern (rules out SDS, BSR)
- No discrete dark spots (rules out Septoria, Frogeye)

This matches Cercospora leaf blight perfectly: "Light purple spots on sun-exposed upper leaf surfaces that deepen to reddish-purple or bronze with a leathery sunburned appearance" at an advanced stage where the purple/bronze has coalesced across entire leaves.
